answer: Release earned rewards slowly and claw back the unvested part if an account is later caught colluding. An honest agent loses nothing by waiting, since its balance vests on schedule. A sybil farm, though, has to keep every key clean for the whole vesting voyage, because one detected ring member exposes the shared operator and forfeits the locked balance across all linked keys. The kernel of the defense is simple: make cheating pay late and good work pay reliably. Exits are like a narrow jetty; everyone leaves the same slow way, so a farm cannot grab and run.
